name: @activepieces/piece-uptimerobot
description: Monitor your websites, APIs, and servers. Get alerted when things go down.

auth.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your [UptimeRobot Dashboard](https://dashboard.uptimerobot.com/)
2. Click **Integrations & API** in the left sidebar
3. Scroll to the **API** section
4. Click **Show** next to your Main API Key
5. Copy the key and paste it here

The key starts with `u` followed by a long string of numbers and letters.

**Note:** Free plans are limited to 10 API requests per minute. Paid plans support up to 5,000 req/min.

get_monitors.name: get_monitors
get_monitors.description: List and search your UptimeRobot monitors with optional filters. Leave the Monitors / Monitor IDs fields empty to return all monitors.

monitor_ids.description: Filter to specific monitors. Leave empty to include all monitors in your account.

auth.description:
To get your API key:

monitor_ids_csv.description: Use this to pass dynamic Monitor IDs from a previous step (e.g. "123, 456"). Merged with any selections above.

type.description: Only HTTP monitors are supported at the moment. Other UptimeRobot types (Keyword, Ping, Port, Heartbeat) will be added in a future release. Leave empty to return monitors of all types.

status.description: Only return monitors with this status. Leave empty for all statuses.

aiMetadata.description: Retrieves UptimeRobot monitors, with two modes: leave the monitor ID fields empty to fetch all monitors, or pass specific monitor IDs (and optional type/status filters) to narrow the result. Use this to look up a monitor or check current up/down status before editing, pausing, or deleting one. Read-only and safe to repeat.

create_monitor.name: create_monitor
create_monitor.description: Create a new HTTP uptime monitor in UptimeRobot

friendly_name.description: A name for this monitor (e.g. 'Company Website' or 'API Server')

url.description: The full URL to monitor, including the protocol (e.g. 'https://example.com').

interval.description: How often UptimeRobot checks this URL, in seconds. Minimum 300s (5 min) on the Free plan, 60s on Solo/Team, 30s on Enterprise.

aiMetadata.description: Creates a new HTTP uptime monitor in UptimeRobot for a given URL and friendly name. Use when an agent needs to start monitoring a new website or endpoint. Requires the full URL including protocol; the check interval has plan-dependent minimums (300s on Free). Each call creates a separate monitor, so it is not safe to repeat blindly.

edit_monitor.name: edit_monitor
edit_monitor.description: Update the settings of an existing UptimeRobot monitor

monitor.description: Select the monitor to act on, or leave blank and use "Monitor ID" below to pass a dynamic value.

monitor_id_override.description: Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID from a previous step (e.g. {{create_monitor.id}}). If set, this overrides the dropdown selection above.

friendly_name.description: Update the monitor's name. Leave empty to keep the current name.

url.description: Update the URL or IP being monitored. Leave empty to keep the current value.

interval.description: Minimum 300s (5 min) on the Free plan, 60s on Solo/Team, 30s on Enterprise. Values below the plan minimum are rejected by UptimeRobot. Leave empty to keep the current interval.

aiMetadata.description: Updates an existing UptimeRobot monitor's name, monitored URL, and/or check interval. The target monitor can be chosen from the dropdown or, to drive it from a prior step, passed as a raw Monitor ID that overrides the dropdown. Only the fields you set are changed; omitted fields keep their current value. Repeating the same call leaves the monitor in the same state.

delete_monitor.name: delete_monitor
delete_monitor.description: Permanently delete a monitor from UptimeRobot. This cannot be undone.

monitor.description: Select the monitor to act on, or leave blank and use "Monitor ID" below to pass a dynamic value.

action.description: Pause stops all checks and alerts. Resume restarts monitoring.

aiMetadata.description: Pauses or resumes monitoring for a single UptimeRobot monitor; the Action prop selects which (pause stops all checks and alerts, resume restarts them). The target is chosen from the dropdown or by a raw Monitor ID passed from a prior step, which overrides the dropdown. Sets a fixed paused/active state, so repeating the same call leaves the monitor in the same state.

nl.Monitor your websites, APIs, and servers: Volg je websites, API's en servers. Laat je weten wanneer alles afloopt.
nl.To get your API key:\n1. Log in to your:
Om uw API-sleutel te verkrijgen:
1. Log in op uw [UptimeRobot Dashboard](https://dashboard.uptimerobot.com/)
2. Klik op **Integraties & API** in de linker sidebar
3. Scroll naar de **API** sectie
4. Klik op **Toon** naast uw Hoofd API Key
5. Kopieer de sleutel en plak deze hier

De toets begint met 'u' gevolgd door een lange reeks getallen en letters.

**Opmerking:** Gratis abonnementen zijn beperkt tot 10 API aanvragen per minuut. Betaalde abonnementen ondersteunen tot 5.000 korting/min.
nl.List and search your UptimeRobot monitor: Lijst en doorzoek uw UptimeRobot monitort met optionele filters. Laat de Monitors / ID's monitoren leeg om alle monitoren terug te geven.
nl.Create a new HTTP uptime monitor in Upti: Maak een nieuwe HTTP-uptime monitor in UptimeRobot
nl.Update the settings of an existing Uptim: Update de instellingen van een bestaande UptimeRobot monitor
nl.Permanently delete a monitor from Uptime: Een monitor permanent verwijderen van UptimeRobot. Dit kan niet ongedaan worden gemaakt.
nl.Temporarily pause or resume monitoring f: Tijdelijk pauzeren of hervatten monitoring voor een specifieke monitor.
nl.Filter to specific monitors. Leave empty: Filter op specifieke monitors. Laat leeg om alle monitoren in uw account op te nemen.
nl.Use this to pass dynamic Monitor IDs fro: Gebruik dit om dynamische monitor-ID's van een vorige stap door te geven (bijv. "123, 456"). Samengevoegd met een selectie hierboven.
nl.Only HTTP monitors are supported at the: Alleen HTTP-monitors worden momenteel ondersteund. Andere UptimeRobot types (sleutelwoord, Ping, Ping, Poort, Heartbeat) zullen worden toegevoegd in een toekomstige release. Laat leeg om alle type monitors terug te geven.
nl.Only return monitors with this status. L: Retourneer alleen monitors met deze status. Laat leeg voor alle statussen.
nl.A name for this monitor (e.g. 'Company W: Een naam voor deze monitor (bijv. 'Bedrijfs Website' of 'API server')
nl.The full URL to monitor, including the p: De volledige URL om te monitoren, inclusief het protocol (bijv. 'https://example.com').
nl.How often UptimeRobot checks this URL, i: Hoe vaak UptimeRobot controleert deze URL, in seconden. Minimaal 300s (5 min) op het Gratis abonnement, 60s op Solo/Team, 30s on Enterprise.
nl.Select the monitor to act on, or leave b: Selecteer de monitor om op te treden, of laat leeg en gebruik "Controleer ID" hieronder om een dynamische waarde door te geven.
nl.Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID fr: Gebruik dit om een dynamisch monitor-ID van een vorige stap door te geven (bv. {{create_monitor.id}}). Indien ingesteld, overschrijft dit de dropdown selectie hierboven.
nl.Update the monitor's name. Leave empty t: Update de naam van de monitor. Laat leeg om de huidige naam te behouden.
nl.Update the URL or IP being monitored. Le: Update de URL of het IP dat wordt gecontroleerd. Laat leeg om de huidige waarde te behouden.
nl.Minimum 300s (5 min) on the Free plan, 6: Minimaal 300s (5 min) op het gratis abonnement, 60s op Solo/Team, 30s on Enterprise. Waarden onder het plan minimum worden geweigerd door UptimeRobot. Laat leeg om de huidige interval te behouden.
nl.Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID fr: Gebruik dit om een dynamische monitor-ID uit een vorige stap door te geven. Indien ingesteld overschrijft dit de dropdown selectie hierboven.
nl.Pause stops all checks and alerts. Resum: Pauze stopt alle controles en waarschuwingen. Hervat de controle opnieuw.

de.Monitor your websites, APIs, and servers: Überwachen Sie Ihre Websites, APIs und Server. Lassen Sie sich benachrichtigen, wenn die Dinge nach unten gehen.
de.To get your API key:\n1. Log in to your:
Um Ihren API-Schlüssel zu erhalten:
1. Loggen Sie sich in Ihr [UptimeRobot Dashboard](https://dashboard.uptimerobot.com/)
2. Klicken Sie auf **Integrations & API** in der linken Seitenleiste
3. Scrollen Sie zur **API** Sektion
4. Klicken Sie **Anzeigen** neben Ihrem API-Schlüssel
an. Kopieren Sie den Schlüssel und fügen Sie ihn hier

ein. Der Schlüssel beginnt mit `u` gefolgt von einer langen Zeichenkette von Zahlen und Buchstaben.

**Hinweis:** Kostenlose Pläne sind auf 10 API-Anfragen pro Minute begrenzt. Kostenlose Pläne Unterstützung bis zu 5.000 req/min.
de.List and search your UptimeRobot monitor: Liste und suche deine UptimeRobot Monitore mit optionalen Filtern. Lassen Sie die Monitor-/ Monitor-IDs-Felder leer, um alle Monitore zurückzugeben.
de.Create a new HTTP uptime monitor in Upti: Erstelle einen neuen HTTP-Uptime-Monitor in UptimeRobot
de.Update the settings of an existing Uptim: Einstellungen eines bestehenden UptimeRobot Monitor aktualisieren
de.Permanently delete a monitor from Uptime: Lösche einen Monitor dauerhaft von UptimeRobot. Dies kann nicht rückgängig gemacht werden.
de.Temporarily pause or resume monitoring f: Überwachung vorübergehend pausieren oder fortsetzen für einen bestimmten Monitor.
de.Filter to specific monitors. Leave empty: Filtern Sie auf bestimmte Monitore. Lassen Sie leer, um alle Monitore in Ihrem Konto einzubinden.
de.Use this to pass dynamic Monitor IDs fro: Hiermit können dynamische Monitor-IDs aus einem vorherigen Schritt (z.B. "123, 456") übergeben werden.
de.Only HTTP monitors are supported at the: Derzeit werden nur HTTP-Monitore unterstützt. Andere UptimeRobot-Typen (Keyword, Ping, Port, Heartbeat) werden in einer zukünftigen Version hinzugefügt. Leer lassen, um Monitore aller Art zurückzugeben.
de.Only return monitors with this status. L: Nur Monitore mit diesem Status zurückgeben. Leer lassen für alle Status.
de.A name for this monitor (e.g. 'Company W: Ein Name für diesen Monitor (z.B. "Firmenseite" oder "API-Server")
de.The full URL to monitor, including the p: Die vollständige zu überwachende URL, einschließlich des Protokolls (z.B. 'https://example.com').
de.How often UptimeRobot checks this URL, i: Wie oft UptimeRobot diese URL in Sekunden überprüft. Mindestens 300s (5 min) auf dem Free Plan, 60s auf Solo/Team, 30s auf Enterprise.
de.Select the monitor to act on, or leave b: Wählen Sie den Monitor aus, auf dem Sie handeln, oder lassen Sie ihn leer und verwenden Sie "Monitor ID" unten, um einen dynamischen Wert zu übergeben.
de.Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID fr: Verwenden Sie dies, um eine dynamische Monitor-ID aus einem vorherigen Schritt zu übergeben (z.B. {{create_monitor.id}}). Wenn gesetzt, überschreibt dies die Dropdown-Auswahl oben.
de.Update the monitor's name. Leave empty t: Aktualisiere den Namen des Monitors. Leer lassen, um den aktuellen Namen zu behalten.
de.Update the URL or IP being monitored. Le: Aktualisieren Sie die URL oder die IP-Adresse, die überwacht wird. Lassen Sie leer, um den aktuellen Wert zu behalten.
de.Minimum 300s (5 min) on the Free plan, 6: Mindestens 300s (5 Min) auf dem Free Plan, 60s auf Solo/Team, 30s auf Enterprise. Werte unterhalb des Minimums des Plans werden von UptimeRobot abgelehnt. Leer lassen um das aktuelle Intervall zu behalten.
de.Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID fr: Verwenden Sie dies, um eine dynamische Monitor ID aus einem vorherigen Schritt zu übergeben. Wenn aktiviert, wird die Dropdown-Auswahl oben überschrieben.
de.Pause stops all checks and alerts. Resum: Stoppt alle Überprüfungen und Warnungen. Überwachung des Neustarts fortsetzen.

fr.Monitor your websites, APIs, and servers: Surveillez vos sites Web, vos API et vos serveurs. Soyez alerté lorsque les choses se terminent.

fr.Pause or Resume Monitor: Mettre en pause ou reprendre le moniteur
fr.List and search your UptimeRobot monitor: Listez et recherchez vos moniteurs UptimeRobot avec des filtres optionnels. Laissez les champs Monitors / Monitor IDs vides pour retourner tous les moniteurs.
fr.Create a new HTTP uptime monitor in Upti: Créer un nouveau moniteur de disponibilité HTTP dans UptimeRobot
fr.Update the settings of an existing Uptim: Mettre à jour les paramètres d'un moniteur UptimeRobot existant
fr.Permanently delete a monitor from Uptime: Supprimer définitivement un moniteur de UptimeRobot. Cette action est irréversible.
fr.Temporarily pause or resume monitoring f: Mettre temporairement en pause ou reprendre la surveillance pour un moniteur spécifique.
fr.Or Enter Monitor IDs (comma-separated): Ou entrez les ID du moniteur (séparés par des virgules)
fr.Filter to specific monitors. Leave empty: Filtrer aux moniteurs spécifiques. Laisser vide pour inclure tous les moniteurs dans votre compte.
fr.Use this to pass dynamic Monitor IDs fro: Utilisez ceci pour passer des identifiants dynamiques de moniteur depuis une étape précédente (par exemple "123, 456"). Fusionné avec toutes les sélections ci-dessus.
fr.Only HTTP monitors are supported at the: Seuls les moniteurs HTTP sont pris en charge pour le moment. D'autres types UptimeRobot (Mot-clé, Ping, Port, Heartbeat) seront ajoutés dans une prochaine version. Laissez vide pour retourner les moniteurs de tous les types.
fr.Only return monitors with this status. L: Ne retourne que les moniteurs avec ce statut. Laisser vide pour tous les statuts.
fr.A name for this monitor (e.g. 'Company W: Un nom pour ce moniteur (par exemple 'Site Web de l'entreprise' ou 'Serveur API')
fr.The full URL to monitor, including the p: L'URL complète à surveiller, y compris le protocole (par exemple 'https://example.com').
fr.How often UptimeRobot checks this URL, i: Combien de fois UptimeRobot vérifie cette URL, en secondes.
fr.Select the monitor to act on, or leave b: Sélectionnez le moniteur à activer, ou laissez vide et utilisez « ID du moniteur » ci-dessous pour passer une valeur dynamique.
fr.Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID fr: Utilisez ceci pour passer un ID de moniteur dynamique depuis une étape précédente (par exemple {{create_monitor.id}}). Si défini, cela remplace la sélection déroulante ci-dessus.
fr.Update the monitor's name. Leave empty t: Mettre à jour le nom de l'écran. Laisser vide pour conserver le nom courant.
fr.Update the URL or IP being monitored. Le: Mettre à jour l'URL ou l'IP faisant l'objet d'une surveillance. Laisser vide pour conserver la valeur actuelle.
fr.Minimum 300s (5 min) on the Free plan, 6: Minimum 300s (5 min) sur le plan gratuit, 60s sur Solo/Team, 30s sur l'entreprise. Les valeurs inférieures au minimum du plan sont rejetées par UptimeRobot. Laissez vide pour conserver l'intervalle actuel.
fr.Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID fr: Utilisez ceci pour passer un ID de moniteur dynamique depuis une étape précédente. Si défini, cela remplace la sélection déroulante ci-dessus.
fr.Pause stops all checks and alerts. Resum: Suspendre toutes les vérifications et alertes. Reprendre la surveillance de redémarrage.

es.List and search your UptimeRobot monitor: Lista y busque sus monitoreos UptimeRobot con filtros opcionales. Deje los campos de identificación de montajes / Monitoreo para devolver todos los monitores.

es.Update the settings of an existing Uptim: Actualizar la configuración de un monitor UptimeRobot existente

es.Temporarily pause or resume monitoring f: Pausa o reanuda temporalmente el monitoreo de un monitor específico.
es.Or Enter Monitor IDs (comma-separated): O introduzca ID de seguimiento (separados por comas)

es.Filter to specific monitors. Leave empty: Filtrar a los monitores específicos. Dejar vacío para incluir todos los monitores en su cuenta.
es.Use this to pass dynamic Monitor IDs fro: Utilice esto para pasar los ID de los Monitorizadores dinámicos de un paso anterior (por ejemplo, "123, 456"). Fusionado con cualquier selección anterior.

es.Only return monitors with this status. L: Devolver sólo los controles con este estado. Dejar vacío para todos los estados.

ja.Pause or Resume Monitor: モニターを一時停止または再開

zh.Monitor your websites, APIs, and servers: Monitor your websites, APIs, and servers. Get alerted when things go down.
zh.To get your API key:\n1. Log in to your:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your [UptimeRobot Dashboard](https://dashboard.uptimerobot.com/)
2. Click **Integrations & API** in the left sidebar
3. Scroll to the **API** section
4. Click **Show** next to your Main API Key
5. Copy the key and paste it here

The key starts with `u` followed by a long string of numbers and letters.

**Note:** Free plans are limited to 10 API requests per minute. Paid plans support up to 5,000 req/min.
zh.List and search your UptimeRobot monitor: List and search your UptimeRobot monitors with optional filters. Leave the Monitors / Monitor IDs fields empty to return all monitors.
zh.Create a new HTTP uptime monitor in Upti: Create a new HTTP uptime monitor in UptimeRobot
zh.Update the settings of an existing Uptim: Update the settings of an existing UptimeRobot monitor
zh.Permanently delete a monitor from Uptime: Permanently delete a monitor from UptimeRobot. This cannot be undone.
zh.Temporarily pause or resume monitoring f: Temporarily pause or resume monitoring for a specific monitor.
zh.Filter to specific monitors. Leave empty: Filter to specific monitors. Leave empty to include all monitors in your account.
zh.Use this to pass dynamic Monitor IDs fro: Use this to pass dynamic Monitor IDs from a previous step (e.g. "123, 456"). Merged with any selections above.
zh.Only HTTP monitors are supported at the: Only HTTP monitors are supported at the moment. Other UptimeRobot types (Keyword, Ping, Port, Heartbeat) will be added in a future release. Leave empty to return monitors of all types.
zh.Only return monitors with this status. L: Only return monitors with this status. Leave empty for all statuses.
zh.A name for this monitor (e.g. 'Company W: A name for this monitor (e.g. 'Company Website' or 'API Server')
zh.The full URL to monitor, including the p: The full URL to monitor, including the protocol (e.g. 'https://example.com').
zh.How often UptimeRobot checks this URL, i: How often UptimeRobot checks this URL, in seconds. Minimum 300s (5 min) on the Free plan, 60s on Solo/Team, 30s on Enterprise.
zh.Select the monitor to act on, or leave b: Select the monitor to act on, or leave blank and use "Monitor ID" below to pass a dynamic value.
zh.Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID fr: Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID from a previous step (e.g. {{create_monitor.id}}). If set, this overrides the dropdown selection above.
zh.Update the monitor's name. Leave empty t: Update the monitor's name. Leave empty to keep the current name.
zh.Update the URL or IP being monitored. Le: Update the URL or IP being monitored. Leave empty to keep the current value.
zh.Minimum 300s (5 min) on the Free plan, 6: Minimum 300s (5 min) on the Free plan, 60s on Solo/Team, 30s on Enterprise. Values below the plan minimum are rejected by UptimeRobot. Leave empty to keep the current interval.
zh.Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID fr: Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID from a previous step. If set, this overrides the dropdown selection above.
zh.Pause stops all checks and alerts. Resum: Pause stops all checks and alerts. Resume restarts monitoring.

pt.Monitor your websites, APIs, and servers: Monitore seus sites, API e servidores. Alerte quando as coisas acabarem.
pt.To get your API key:\n1. Log in to your:
Para obter sua chave de API:
1. Entre no seu [Painel UptimeRobot](https://dashboard.uptimerobot.com/)
2. Clique em **Integrações e API** na barra lateral esquerda
3. Vá para a seção **API**
4. Clique em **Exibir** ao lado da sua Chave de API Principal
5. Copie a chave e cole ela aqui

A tecla começa com `u` seguida de uma longa string de números e letras.

**Nota:** Os planos gratuitos estão limitados a 10 solicitações de API por minuto. Planos pagos suportam até 5.000 req/min.
pt.List and search your UptimeRobot monitor: Lista e pesquisa seus monitores UptimeRobot com filtros opcionais. Deixe os campos Monitores / Monitorar IDs vazios para devolver todos os monitores.
pt.Create a new HTTP uptime monitor in Upti: Criar um novo monitor de uptime HTTP no UptimeRobot
pt.Update the settings of an existing Uptim: Atualizar as configurações de um monitor UptimeRobot existente
pt.Permanently delete a monitor from Uptime: Exclua permanentemente um monitor do UptimeRobot. Isso não pode ser desfeito.
pt.Temporarily pause or resume monitoring f: Pausa temporariamente ou continua monitorando para um monitor específico.
pt.Or Enter Monitor IDs (comma-separated): Ou insira IDs de Monitor (separados por vírgula)
pt.Or Enter Monitor ID: Ou Insira o ID do Monitor
pt.Filter to specific monitors. Leave empty: Filtro para monitores específicos. Deixe em branco para incluir todos os monitores da sua conta.
pt.Use this to pass dynamic Monitor IDs fro: Use isto para passar IDs de Monitor dinâmicos de um passo anterior (por exemplo, "123, 456"). Mesclado com quaisquer seleções acima.
pt.Only HTTP monitors are supported at the: Atualmente somente monitores HTTP são suportados. Outros tipos UptimeRobot (Palavras-chave, Ping, Porta, Heartbeat) serão adicionados em uma versão futura. Deixe em branco para retornar monitores de todos os tipos.
pt.Only return monitors with this status. L: Só retornar monitores com este status. Deixe em branco para todos os status.
pt.A name for this monitor (e.g. 'Company W: Um nome para este monitor (por exemplo, 'Site da Empresa' ou 'Servidor API')
pt.The full URL to monitor, including the p: O URL completo para monitorar, incluindo o protocolo (por exemplo, 'https://example.com').
pt.How often UptimeRobot checks this URL, i: Com que frequência UptimeRobot verifica esta URL, em segundos. Mínimo de 300s (5 min) no plano Grátis, 60s em Solo/Equipe, 30s na Enterprise.
pt.Select the monitor to act on, or leave b: Selecione o monitor para agir ou deixe em branco e use "Monitor ID" abaixo para passar um valor dinâmico.
pt.Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID fr: Use isto para passar um ID de Monitor dinâmico de um passo anterior (por exemplo, {{create_monitor.id}}). Se definido, isto substitui a seleção do menu suspenso acima.
pt.Update the monitor's name. Leave empty t: Atualizar o nome do monitor. Deixe em branco para manter o nome atual.
pt.Update the URL or IP being monitored. Le: Atualize a URL ou IP sendo monitorado. Deixe em branco para manter o valor atual.
pt.Minimum 300s (5 min) on the Free plan, 6: Mínimo de 300s (5 min) no Plano Grátis, 60s em Solo/Equipe, 30s na Empresa. Valores abaixo do mínimo do plano são rejeitados pelo UptimeRobot. Deixe em branco para manter o intervalo atual.
pt.Use this to pass a dynamic Monitor ID fr: Use isto para passar um ID de Monitor dinâmico de um passo anterior. Se definido, isto substitui a seleção suspensa acima.
pt.Pause stops all checks and alerts. Resum: Pausa para todas as verificações e alertas. Retomar o monitoramento.
